profile_text.body:
LAION, which stands for Large-scale Artificial Intelligence Open Network, is a non-profit organization based in Hamburg, Germany. According to its website, it makes machine learning resources available to the general public and provides datasets, tools, and models with the stated aim of liberating machine learning research.

The organization describes its work as encouraging open public education and a more environment-friendly use of resources by reusing existing datasets and models. No specific products, litigation, or other corporate filings are recorded for LAION beyond its non-profit status and location.
